comments.text: PS1 cooperative thread scheduler — iterates TCB array at 0x801FD800 (stride 0x70), dispatches threads with state=2 (ready). Leaves loop-end value in scratchpad after each call.
entity pool initializer — sets entity[0x1C]=1, pushes to pending list at scratchpad[0x204]
display thread entry — state machine (states 9→10→0xB→0→1→4); TCB[0] display thread. TCB[0]+0x48/0x58 = draw callback pointers for buffer A/B, not state values once running.
draw callback for display buffer B — updated every frame by display state machine
draw callback for display buffer A
weapon/projectile dispatch chain — called from FUN_80034524; routes weapon attack logic
entity tick dispatcher — iterates 200 entity slots at 0x800A5970 (stride 0xD4); dispatches each active entity's handler
camera entity handler — reads from camera entity at 0x800A38B8
weapon/projectile chain entry — calls FUN_8001ac00; part of the throw/attack dispatch path
secondary entity dispatcher — iterates 0x800B07D8 pool (4 slots, stride 0xEC); checks entity[0]!=0, dispatches via table_8007d6a4[entity[2]]; handles projectiles and thrown weapons
terrain gate check — reads DAT_800a5399; mode in DAT_800a539a (0=compiled, 1-3=overlay); controls zone boundary transitions
ChangeThread(handle) — cooperative thread context switch; suspends caller, resumes target thread
